brains_directory.explanation: All 14 retained-brain *.json files are rewritten every 30 s by the daemon's own checkpointing (--checkpoint-interval 30 on the running unit, neurofly_daemon.py:796). A control observation with no browser open and no commands sent showed all 14 files change again over 75 idle seconds, so the byte differences are daemon checkpointing, not this sign-off. Nothing under outputs/ was written, renamed or deleted by the sign-off; brain identity and accumulated history are intact (see brain_continuity).
